newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentine debt on June 30 $90.2 billion - official.
newsitem.headline: Argentine debt on June 30 $90.2 billion - official.

text.p: Argentina's public debt rose to $90.2 billion on June 30 from $88.1 billion on March 30, the Economy Ministry said Wednesday.

Of the $90.2 billion, $10.9 billion is bilateral debt, $15.4 billion is debt with multilateral lending agencies, $62.3 billion is denominated in bonds and other instruments and $1.3 billion is owed to private banks.
However, the ministry said that the $2.1 billion increase over the first quarter was not due to new debt but rather to foreign exchange variations and to recalculations of previous, existing debt.
